titulo.alumno: Booking an appointment and giving the necessary details

intro: In this lesson you will practice booking an appointment and giving the necessary details.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Θα ήθελα να κλείσω ένα ραντεβού με τον γιατρό.
frases.alumno: I would like to make an appointment with the doctor.

frases.estudio: Με πονάει ο λαιμός από χθες το βράδυ.
frases.alumno: My throat has hurt since last night.

frases.estudio: Πάρτε αυτό το σιρόπι μετά το φαγητό.

texto: Name the symptom, the body part and when it started; ask for an instruction to be repeated if needed.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the question and locate the symptom or the moment indicated.
